gaps.sentence: We stayed at ___ hotel right next to the station.
gaps.explanation: 'The station' — in a town there is usually one known station; context makes it definite.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).

gaps.sentence: He earns fifty thousand pounds ___ year.
gaps.explanation: 'Fifty thousand a year' — 'a' = per in rates.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
He was offered ___ job in the human resources department.
gaps.explanation: 'A job' — first mention of one of many possible jobs. Note: 'in human resources' takes no article.

gaps.sentence: I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.

gaps.sentence: ___ noise pollution in cities is getting worse.
gaps.explanation: 'Noise pollution' as a general concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ unemployment has fallen sharply this year.
gaps.explanation: Unemployment as a general concept takes no article.
